# Country scope. Does the party in slot SLOT meet its type-specific agenda K (1 or 3)?
cc_pty_slot_agenda_type_met = {
	OR = {
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 1 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_1 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 2 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_2 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 3 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_3 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 4 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_4 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 5 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_5 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 6 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_6 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 7 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_7 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 8 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_8 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 9 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_9 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 10 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_10 = yes }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 11 } cc_pty_agenda$K$_met_type_11 = yes }
	}
}

# Character scope, scope:cc_pty_country set. Is this minister's party one the court still has?
cc_pty_aff_active = {
	OR = {
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 1 } scope:cc_pty_country = { cc_pty_has_type = { TYPE = 1 } } }

# Character scope. Does this character belong to the party in slot SLOT of COUNTRY?
cc_pty_member_of_slot_in = {
	OR = {
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 1 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 1 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 2 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 2 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 3 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 3 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 4 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 4 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 5 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 5 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 6 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 6 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 7 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 7 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 8 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 8 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 9 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 9 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 10 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 10 } } }
		AND = { cc_pty_is_member = { TYPE = 11 } $COUNTRY$ = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 11 } } }
	}
}

# Character scope, scope:cc_pty_country set.
cc_pty_member_of_slot = {
	cc_pty_member_of_slot_in = { SLOT = $SLOT$ COUNTRY = scope:cc_pty_country }
}

# Country scope. Was the party in slot SLOT picked by the realignment in progress?
cc_pty_slot_type_picked = {
	OR = {

		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 2 } has_variable = cc_pty_picked_2 }

		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 4 } has_variable = cc_pty_picked_4 }

# Country scope. Are the parties in slots A and B opposed?
cc_pty_slots_opposed = {
	OR = {
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $A$ TYPE = 1 } cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $B$ TYPE = 2 } }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $A$ TYPE = 2 } cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $B$ TYPE = 1 } }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $A$ TYPE = 1 } cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $B$ TYPE = 11 } }
		AND = { cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $A$ TYPE = 11 } cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $B$ TYPE = 1 } }

# Country scope. Is the party in slot SLOT one that must be placated?
cc_pty_slot_escalates = {
	OR = {
		cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 5 }
		cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 9 }
		cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 11 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Does the party in slot SLOT impose term limits when dominant?
cc_pty_slot_imposes_term_limits = {
	OR = {
		cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 7 }
		cc_pty_slot_is_type = { SLOT = $SLOT$ TYPE = 11 }
	}
}
